general.title: General information to xRegistry and OPC UA

runs.text: xRegistry is an open specification for describing registries of documents. A registry contains groups, a group contains resources, and a resource carries versioned documents together with the metadata that identifies them, so that a document can be published, discovered and retrieved by identity and version rather than by location.

Servers already hold documents of exactly this shape: NodeSet files, schemas, device descriptions, model definitions and their revisions. What they lack is a uniform way to publish them, so each vendor invents its own folder convention and every client has to learn it.

This document defines that uniform way. It maps the xRegistry model onto OPC UA so that a Server exposes its documents as part of its own address space, browsable, readable and writable with the standard Services and with no prior knowledge of the domain.

The namespace metadata provide standardized information about the elements of this namespace, which an aggregating Server relies on. All Nodes defined by this document are static: they are identical in every Server, including the Value Attribute.

The information is provided as an Object of type NamespaceMetadataType, a component of the Namespaces Object of the Server Object. The NamespaceMetadataType ObjectType and its Properties are defined in OPC 10000-5. The same version information is carried by the ModelTableEntry of the UANodeSet XML file.
The IsNamespaceSubset Property is False because the UANodeSet XML file contains the complete namespace. A Server exposing only a subset sets it to True.

Namespaces are used by OPC UA to create unique identifiers across different naming authorities. The NodeId and BrowseName Attributes are identifiers. A Node in the AddressSpace is unambiguously identified by its NodeId; a BrowseName is not unique and is used to build a browse path or to name a standard Property.
